name: triplanarwalls-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: triplanarWalls (pro) flag gate. The effect is invisible from an orbit screenshot (a solid-colour fallback material ignores UVs — see src/apartment/PlanShell.tsx SlopedWallMesh), so this uses a scene-graph oracle instead of pixels: a sloped-top wall's prism geometry (a fixed 36-vertex non-indexed triangle soup, src/floorplan/slopedWall.ts) gets a triplanar 'uv' BufferAttribute only when the flag is on.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: triplanarWalls should be OFF in Simple mode (pro-tier)

waitFor.store: (() => { const w = state.floorPlan.walls.find(w => w.id === window.__wallId); return !!w && w.topHeightEnd === 1.2; })()

steps.name: probe-uv-flag-off
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = await import('/src/scene/pathtrace/hqRenderSource.ts'); const src = m.getHqRenderSource(); if (!src) throw new Error('no live scene/camera source — not in the 3D view'); let found = null; src.scene.traverse((o) => { if (!found && o.isMesh && o.geometry && o.geometry.attributes && o.geometry.attributes.position && o.geometry.attributes.position.count === 36) found = o; }); if (!found) throw new Error('sloped-wall prism mesh (36-vert triangle soup) not found in the scene graph'); window.__hasUvOff = !!found.geometry.attributes.uv; if (window.__hasUvOff) throw new Error('sloped wall prism should NOT carry a uv attribute with triplanarWalls OFF (Simple mode)'); })()

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: triplanarWalls should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: probe-uv-flag-on
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = await import('/src/scene/pathtrace/hqRenderSource.ts'); const src = m.getHqRenderSource(); if (!src) throw new Error('no live scene/camera source'); let found = null; src.scene.traverse((o) => { if (!found && o.isMesh && o.geometry && o.geometry.attributes && o.geometry.attributes.position && o.geometry.attributes.position.count === 36) found = o; }); if (!found) throw new Error('sloped-wall prism mesh not found after enabling Pro'); const uv = found.geometry.attributes.uv; if (!uv) throw new Error('sloped wall prism should carry a uv attribute with triplanarWalls ON (Pro mode)'); if (uv.count !== 36) throw new Error('expected 36 uv coords (1 per vertex), got ' + uv.count); })()

steps.name: probe-uv-flag-off-again
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = await import('/src/scene/pathtrace/hqRenderSource.ts'); const src = m.getHqRenderSource(); if (!src) throw new Error('no live scene/camera source'); let found = null; src.scene.traverse((o) => { if (!found && o.isMesh && o.geometry && o.geometry.attributes && o.geometry.attributes.position && o.geometry.attributes.position.count === 36) found = o; }); if (!found) throw new Error('sloped-wall prism mesh not found after switching back to Simple'); if (found.geometry.attributes.uv) throw new Error('sloped wall prism should lose its uv attribute again once back in Simple mode'); })()
